page.layout: One page of running text, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the middle lines. Running head at top centre, page number top left. Catchword at the foot right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: ad Amnicam portam, unde procedit, no-
men invenit. Caeterae duae portae plateas
excipiunt etiam suas, sed per angulum à
reliquis derivatas, quarum portarum al-
tera à grue machina (Kraenpoorte[?]) al-
tera ab attollendis lapidibus, ut vulgus ar-
bitratur; ut autem veritas habet, à pon-
ticulo lapideo, qui quondam isto in la-
tere civitatis fuit, quem Germani
Stetgentil[?] dicunt, (Stelgentilpoorte[?]) no-
men ferunt. Plateae in urbe erant, cùm
hæc primùm ederem, majores ad xxv I,[?]
minores vii, præter angiportus aliquot.
Majoribus accessit proximis his annis vi-
cesima septima prorsus nova, ædificijs e-
legans, à fori majoris angulo, qui occi-
dentem & boream intuetur, per medi-
um hortum cœnobii Franciscani ducta,
mittens in regionem, quæ ad amnem
porrigitur, ex ipsâ re nova nominata. Mi-
norum quoque numerus crevit. Antiqui-
tus cùm minor esset civitatis fortuna, ut
omnia solent à parvis principiis oriri, pro
mœnibus usa est septo ligneo è trabibus
contexto. Deinde ante annos plùs mi-
nùs cccc. I muro lateritio firmo cum
fossâ

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. Blackletter words (Kraenpoorte, Stetgentil, Stelgentilpoorte) are hard to read on the scan and are marked [?]. "xxv I" is printed in a form I could not settle; kept as printed with [?]. "fepto" in the print is read as septo. The margin note "Vrbis incrementa." is printed in italics, split over two lines with a hyphen after "in-". The catchword "fossâ" is printed with a long s, transcribed as plain s. The faint watermark in the bottom right corner is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
